hints.title: Prefix Subsequence Matching
hints.text: To minimize characters appended to s, find the longest prefix of t that already appears as a subsequence in s.

hints.title: Two Index Tracking
hints.text: Maintain an index i in s and an index j in t. Advance j whenever s[i] == t[j].

hints.title: Remaining Characters Calculation
hints.text: The minimum characters required to append to s is len(t) - j.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Greedy Traversal Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass through string s matching characters of prefix of t.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all possible substring additions causes exponential state search.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Greedily matches prefix of t in s using two pointers.
